lead_raw_text:
The structure of Bi4Ag2Cu2S8 (reduced formula Bi2AgCuS4) crystallizes in the cubic space group F-43m (No. 216), with 16 atoms per unit cell distributed over four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Ag and Cu each adopt tetrahedral environments coordinated by four S atoms, while Bi centers exhibit an eight-vertex coordination polyhedron with eight S neighbors. Corner-sharing between Ag- and Cu-centered tetrahedra and edge-sharing between Bi polyhedra and the Ag or Cu tetrahedra are observed. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 16 sites.
